title: cyanea cylindrocalyx
intro: Cyanea cylindrocalyx, commonly known as Hawaiian Blue Haze, is a species of flowering plant in the family Goodeniaceae. It has been traditionally used in Hawaiian medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and sore throat. The plant is believed to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its potential in treating infections and wounds. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
